advisory.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs

accepted_risk: A regular-expression denial of service in picomatch glob matching (<=4.0.7; no patched version has been published) reaches only the frontend build tooling (vite, laravel-vite-plugin and their glob helpers). It can at worst stall a build on a pathological glob pattern. It is not reachable from the running application, any customer or tenant data, or any deployed artifact.
compensating_controls: Every affected package is dev-only build tooling: package-lock.json marks each of them "dev": true and none is in package.json dependencies, optionalDependencies or peerDependencies. The gate verifies this on every run.
node_modules is never part of a production artifact; public/build is committed and the build runs only on the deploy-side builder.
The committed public/build output is verified byte-for-byte by scripts/tests/verify-committed-vite-build.py.
Glob patterns come from reviewed repository configuration (vite.config.js and the laravel-vite-plugin refresh list), never from external or user input.
No Vite dev server runs in CI or in production.
renewal: Renewal requires an explicit new Owner action (a new approval reference and a new expiry date in this file, reviewed in a pull request). The gate fails on and after the expiry date (UTC).
removal: As soon as a stable picomatch version newer than 4.0.7 exists the gate fails by itself. Upgrade the dependency tree (npm update, rebuild, commit public/build), restore the plain `npm audit --audit-level=high` CI step and delete this file, scripts/npm_audit_gate.py and its test; see docs/SECURITY_EXCEPTIONS.md.
